title: Unveiling the intrinsic electrochemical mechanism of supporting electrolyte and the interaction mechanism in electrochemical oxidation of tetracycline with nano-PbO2
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,1288-1304
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00842A, Paper
Yaxuan Wang, Peitong Cen, Hongyu Wang, Chenxi Li, Ziyin Xia, Guoqing Wu, Meng Li, Lei Huang, Jia Yan, Shaoqi Zhou, Ce-Hui Mo, Hongguo Zhang
This paper studies the intrinsic electrochemical mechanisms of supporting electrolytes and their interaction with nano-PbO2 during the electrochemical oxidation of tetracycline, providing insights into their role in enhancing degradation efficiency.
